seed: Objects of type `block` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [arm] show mixed outcomes: x x22, no_change x10, tags x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Ring A1/A2 y+-6 carrying on-beam blocks; push chain from new ring/beam rects; vertical move cancels if any block leaves the colour-4 field.
Beam A4/A3 w+-6 (1..field right); next/collected block at tip-4 = hooked, drags on-beam blocks; unhooked extend pushes swept blocks; failed group -> beam slides alone.
Hypothesis resolved: block A3 x vs no_change = hooked group passing field edge (beam alone); tags = collect/revert; clicks are full no-ops (click position irrelevant).
Render: erase to bg (4 field, rail 2/3 period 6, else 5), draw ring<beam<blocks; legend swatch centre 2x2 = 0 while collected.
